C1.rule: Mechanical, one owned file, fully specified, no design choice

C2.rule: Bounded implementation or tests, clear spec, one or two owned files and their tests

C3.rule: Cross-module design; changes a gate or the ledger contract; wrong means every project inherits it

C4.rule: Planning, merging, reconciling, anything in a project's real data, a sponsor decision

phases.name: Handover
phases.goal: Short item leads end safely and a thin dispatcher keeps work moving without the sponsor.
phases.exit: H-01 to H-03 merged; one full bundle runs dispatcher → item lead → closing check → next lead with no sponsor action.

phases.name: Research
phases.goal: Questions that need reading, not writing, before they become items, a proposal, or a decline.
phases.exit: Every X row is done only when it becomes items, a numbered proposal, or a recorded decline with the reason -- never a report nobody acted on.

items.title: Closing check: bin/handover --check
items.what: Before a lead stops it must prove four things: every sponsor message since it started has an ask row; every running agent is in the ledger with its worktree; the checkpoint matches the ledger; warmup --check reads ready. Exit 0 or a list of what is missing.
items.done: Tool in common-rules bin/ with tests, each of the four checks shown failing on a broken fixture first; OPERATING-RULES names it.

items.title: Thin dispatcher and short item leads
items.what: A dispatcher session holds only the queue: ledgers, asks, which bundle runs where. It never reads diffs, logs or images. Each bundle gets a short item lead that builds, merges, passes H-01 and ends. The lead prompt template gains a dispatcher form and an item-lead form.
items.done: Both forms in templates/lead-prompt.md with a Standard change line; dispatcher context measured under 150k across a full bundle.

items.title: The dispatcher starts the next lead without asking
items.what: Find and prove the mechanism by which a session starts a new item-lead session with no sponsor click (desktop session tools, scheduled task, or CLI). Stop list unchanged (D4): destructive or irreversible work, work outside the plan, a decision the plan records as the sponsor's.
items.done: One item lead started by the dispatcher and finished with no sponsor action, recorded with the session ids; if no mechanism works, blocked with owner sponsor and the reason.
